step1_analysis.circuit_type: Variable Gain Amplifier (VGA) / Active Feedback Amplifier
step1_analysis.description: A wideband amplifier stage utilizing an active feedback loop to cancel low-frequency variations and stabilize the operating point. The forward path consists of cascaded amplifier stages with current mirror biasing, originally designed with BJTs for linear-in-dB gain control.

paper_reference.title: A Variable Gain Amplifier With 50-dB Control Range for 900-MHz Applications

max_gain.description: Maximum AC voltage gain of the amplifier

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain is determined by the transconductance of the forward path and the active feedback factor. With NMOS gm ~ 10mS at 1mA bias, closed-loop gain is lower than the BJT equivalent.
sky130_expected.reasoning: MOSFETs have lower intrinsic gm/Id compared to BJTs, leading to a reduced maximum open-loop and closed-loop gain under similar bias currents.

gain_900MHz.description: Voltage gain at the target operating frequency of 900 MHz

sky130_expected.calculation: Evaluated at 900 MHz. Since SKY130 fT is ~30 GHz, the gain at 900 MHz should be very close to the maximum low-frequency gain.
sky130_expected.reasoning: 900 MHz is well within the bandwidth of the SKY130 130nm process.

bandwidth_3dB.description: Upper 3-dB cutoff frequency of the amplifier

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the dominant pole at node A or N4. Cgs of SKY130 NMOS is small enough to push the pole beyond 1 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The active feedback and low node impedances (due to diode-connected M15 and source followers) inherently broadband the circuit.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the circuit

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_total. With VDD=1.8V and estimated total bias current of 5-8 mA across the branches.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled down for 1.8V supply and typical CMOS bias currents used in the testbench.

sky130_expected.calculation: Limited by VDD (1.8V) and the Vdsat of the cascaded transistors.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The stacked configuration (e.g., M13, M15) restricts the maximum linear voltage swing before transistors enter the triode region.

sky130_expected.calculation: Typically 10-15 dB higher than P1dB. With lower VDD, linearity degrades.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Lower supply voltage (1.8V vs 2.8V) and CMOS non-linearities reduce the absolute OIP3 compared to the BiCMOS original.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain, bandwidth, and transient output swing of the VGA core. Original NPN BJTs are mapped to SKY130 NMOS transistors to evaluate the topology in a modern CMOS process.
step3_testbench.spice:
* VGA Active Feedback Amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

* Parameterized dimensions for the mapped MOSFETs
.param W_bias=10u L_bias=0.15u
.param W_amp=20u L_amp=0.15u

* Supply and Bias Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVR Vr 0 1.2
* Input signal at Vg (DC bias + AC + Transient sine wave at 900MHz)
VVG Vg 0 dc 1.2 ac 1 sin(1.2 0.01 900Meg)

* Current sources from original netlist
I15 VDD A 2m
I12 N3 0 1m

* Passive components
R4 Vr N1 1k
R5 Vg N3 50
R6 N5 0 1k

* DUT: Original NPNs mapped to SKY130 NMOS (D G S B)
XM18 N1 N1 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=W_bias L=L_bias
XM19 N2 N1 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=W_bias L=L_bias
XM11 VDD N3 N2 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=W_amp L=L_amp
XM16 N4 N2 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=W_amp L=L_amp
XM15 A A N4 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=W_amp L=L_amp
XM13 A N4 N5 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=W_amp L=L_amp
XM20 N5 N1 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=W_bias L=L_bias
XM14 N6 N5 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=W_amp L=L_amp
XM17 VDD A N6 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=W_amp L=L_amp
XM12 VDD A N3 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 W=W_bias L=L_bias

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point & Power
  op
  let power_consumption = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power_consumption

  * 2. AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
  ac dec 50 1Meg 10Gig
  let gain_db = vdb(N6)
  
  meas ac max_gain max gain_db
  meas ac gain_900MHz find gain_db at=900Meg
  
  let gain_3db = max_gain - 3
  meas ac bandwidth_3db when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1

  * 3. Transient Analysis for Output Swing
  tran 10p 5n
  meas tran vout_max max v(N6)
  meas tran vout_min min v(N6)
  meas tran output_swing_pp pp v(N6)
  
  quit
.endc
